verdict.rationale: jo's own docs describe giving it 'a job and a schedule' to produce recurring outputs (weekly plan, morning priorities) 'without asking each time' (jo-docs-8). They also say it runs on an always-available personal cloud machine that works overnight, reading inputs and preparing your morning before you wake (jo-docs-10, jo-docs-13, jo-probe-1). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how automations are configured and managed (trigger types, editing, monitoring, failure handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs run reliably.
